scenarios.name: Clear an incompatible search and type filter

scenario_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native`
the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software
the recent list includes a part named "Part26" and other document types
the user searches recent documents for "Part26"
the user opens Filter and selects Assembly
the filter control indicates one active filter
the user activates Clear search and filters
the broader recent list includes parts and assemblies
All is selected under Date Modified
